title: How a 100+ MPH Police Chase Ended in 5 Seconds
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 13, 2024, Fond du Lac County Sheriff's deputies located Deandre Bradshaw, a wanted suspect with multiple felony warrants believed to be armed and dangerous, driving a black Nissan Altima. When deputies attempted a high-risk traffic stop, Bradshaw fled, ramming a parked vehicle and leading police on a high-speed pursuit. The chase continued until it came to an end when his vehicle became disabled and was finally arrested. Bradshaw later admitted to taking oxycodone just before or during the chase and tested positive for Amphetamine, Cannabinoid, and Methamphetamine.
